title: NASA's Pluto fact sheet: mass 0.01303×10^24 kg and five satellites
summary: The sheet lists Pluto's mass as 0.01303 × 10^24 kg, equatorial radius 1188 km, mean density 1854 kg/m^3, sidereal orbit 90,560 days, and 5 natural satellites.
body: The sheet lists Pluto's mass as 0.01303 × 10^24 kg, equatorial radius 1188 km, mean density 1854 kg/m^3, sidereal orbit 90,560 days, and 5 natural satellites. It lists a planetary ring system as No. NASA's separate planet count, already carded, groups Pluto with the dwarf planets. This card is the fact sheet's numbers, not a vote on that classification. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last updated on the page: 2024-01-11.
